    std::getline(std::cin, line1);

    int countOut = 0;
    int len = 0;

        if (c == '(') {
            maxLen = std::max(maxLen, len);
            len = 0;
            inBrackets = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (len > 0) countOut++;
            len = 0;
            inBrackets = false;

            if (inBrackets && len > 0) countOut++;
            else if (!inBrackets) maxLen = std::max(maxLen, len);
            len = 0;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }
    maxLen = std::max(maxLen, len);
    std::cout << maxLen << " " << countOut << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
